+def _single_data_span(raw: str) -> tuple[int, int] | None:
+    data_pos = raw.find("data:")
+    if data_pos == -1 or (data_pos != 0 and raw[data_pos - 1] not in "\r\n"):
+        return None
+    data_start = data_pos + 5
+    next_lf = raw.find("\n", data_start)
+    next_cr = raw.find("\r", data_start)
+    if next_lf == -1:
+        data_end = next_cr
+    elif next_cr == -1:
+        data_end = next_lf
+    else:
+        data_end = next_cr if next_cr < next_lf else next_lf
+    if data_end == -1:
+        data_end = len(raw)
+    if raw.find("data:", data_end) != -1:
+        return None
+    if data_start < data_end and raw[data_start] == " ":
+        data_start += 1
+    return data_start, data_end

+def _handle_content_delta(
+    raw: str, blocks: dict[int, dict[str, Any]], parts: dict[int, list[str]]
+) -> bool:
+    span = _single_data_span(raw)
+    if span is None:
+        return False
+    pos, data_end = span
+    prefix = '{"type": "content_block_delta", "index": '
+    if not raw.startswith(prefix, pos):
+        return False
+    pos += len(prefix)
+    idx_start = pos
+    while pos < data_end and "0" <= raw[pos] <= "9":
+        pos += 1
+    if pos == idx_start or not raw.startswith(', "delta": {"type": "', pos):
+        return False
+    idx = int(raw[idx_start:pos])
+    pos += len(', "delta": {"type": "')
+
+    if raw.startswith('text_delta", "text": ', pos):
+        pos += len('text_delta", "text": ')
+        field = "text"
+    elif raw.startswith('thinking_delta", "thinking": ', pos):
+        pos += len('thinking_delta", "thinking": ')
+        field = "thinking"
+    elif raw.startswith('input_json_delta", "partial_json": ', pos):
+        pos += len('input_json_delta", "partial_json": ')
+        field = "partial_json"
+    elif raw.startswith('signature_delta", "signature": ', pos):
+        pos += len('signature_delta", "signature": ')
+        field = "signature"
+    else:
+        return False
+
+    try:
+        value, pos = _JSON_DECODER.raw_decode(raw, pos)

+        parts[idx] = []

+    else:
+        parts[idx].append(value)
